# Copilot Instructions

Use the repository's root `AGENTS.md` as the shared source of project guidance. Keep Copilot-specific instructions here only when they cannot be expressed in that shared file.

ECC skills are available in `.github/skills/`; use a skill when its description matches the task. Reusable Copilot Chat prompts are in `.github/prompts/`.

Repository-specific Copilot agents are available in `.github/agents/`. In Copilot CLI, use `/agent` to browse and select one for a focused task. Agent profiles do not automatically run or grant additional tools.
